notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G/U}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G/U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
If needed, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {G/U}.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G/U}, this combo nets infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saprolings, and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo.
